test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. A sits second from the left. Only two people sit between A and C. Only three people sit between D and F and D is an immediate neighbour of A. B is an immediate neighbour of D and E is not an immediate neighbour of C. Who sits to the extreme right?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) A sits second from the left. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d256bbb0616c5f317452da71487e000a8cec08bbc0a0073db95c5f7c214415a1.png] 

2) Only two people sit between A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d618c0224e161fcdce01ab23aea772366a61345680a69dfff144cae3bc8dcfa.png] 

3) Only three people sit between D and F and D is an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef683b48b095551c402e8d22a97a8a458179a199ea754ca60a0b8c72c18fade8.png] 

4) B is an immediate neighbour of D and E is not an immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f2d472b9d7df1df912a1d05e93191739b41ae4cc2369bef1bdd6a7d772e431e.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/083daa659c951bce881ee335ed9f9d30973057e5a5120f742ff4888ac6e3092b.png] 

Here, we can see that F sits to the extreme right.

Hence, the correct answer is **"F"**.
